lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਹ ਰਚਹੁ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਬੰਧਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: re man bin har jah rachahu tah tah ba(n)dhan paahi ||
lines.translation: O mind: without the Lord, whatever you are involved in shall bind you in chains.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਸਾਕਤ ਤੇਊ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jih bidh katahoo na chhooteeai saakat teoo kamaahi ||
lines.translation: The faithless cynic does those deeds which will never allow him to be emancipated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਰਮ ਰਤ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਭਾਰੁ ਅਫਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau hau karate karam rat taa ko bhaar aphaar ||
lines.translation: Acting in egotism, selfishness and conceit, the lovers of rituals carry the unbearable load.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਉ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਤਉ ਏਊ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: preet nahee jau naam siu tau eoo karam bikaar ||
lines.translation: When there is no love for the Naam, then these rituals are corrupt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਧੇ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜੇਵਰੀ ਮੀਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: baadhe jam kee jevaree meethee maaiaa ra(n)g ||
lines.translation: The rope of death binds those who are in love with the sweet taste of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੇ ਮੋਹੇ ਨਹ ਬੁਝਹਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਹੂ ਸੰਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhram ke mohe nah bujhahi so prabh sadahoo sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: Deluded by doubt, they do not understand that God is always with them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੇਖੈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਛੂਟੀਐ ਕਾਚੀ ਭੀਤਿ ਨ ਸੁਧਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: lekhai ganat na chhooteeai kaachee bheet na sudh ||
lines.translation: When their accounts are called for, they shall not be released; their wall of mud cannot be washed clean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤਿਹ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬੁਧਿ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: jisahi bujhaae naanakaa tih guramukh niramal budh ||9||
lines.translation: One who is made to understand - O Nanak, that Gurmukh obtains immaculate understanding. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਟੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਜਾਸੁ ਕੇ ਹੋਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: toote ba(n)dhan jaas ke hoaa saadhoo sa(n)g ||
lines.translation: One whose bonds are cut away joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਰਾਤੇ ਰੰਗ ਏਕ ਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੂੜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo raate ra(n)g ek kai naanak gooRaa ra(n)g ||1||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with the Love of the One Lord, O Nanak, take on the deep and lasting color of His Love. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਰਾ ਰੰਗਹੁ ਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaraa ra(n)gahu iaa man apanaa ||
lines.translation: RARRA: Dye this heart of yours in the color of the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਜਪੁ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam japahu jap rasanaa ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - chant it with your tongue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਰੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
lines.transliteration: re re daragah kahai na kooo ||
lines.translation: In the Court of the Lord, no one shall speak harshly to you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਬੈਠੁ ਆਦਰੁ ਸੁਭ ਦੇਊ ॥
lines.transliteration: aau baith aadar subh deoo ||
lines.translation: Everyone shall welcome you, saying, "Come, and sit down."

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਮਹਲੀ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤੂ ਬਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: uaa mahalee paavahi too baasaa ||
lines.translation: In that Mansion of the Lord's Presence, you shall find a home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਨਹ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran nah hoi binaasaa ||
lines.translation: There is no birth or death, or destruction there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਓ ਧੁਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: masatak karam likhio dhur jaa kai ||
lines.translation: One who has such karma written on his forehead,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਪੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: har sa(n)pai naanak ghar taa kai ||10||
lines.translation: O Nanak, has the wealth of the Lord in his home. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚ ਝੂਠ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮੋਹ ਬਿਆਪਤ ਮੂੜੇ ਅੰਧ ॥
lines.transliteration: laalach jhooth bikaar moh biaapat mooRe a(n)dh ||
lines.translation: Greed, falsehood, corruption and emotional attachment entangle the blind and the foolish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਗਿ ਪਰੇ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਬੰਧ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: laag pare duraga(n)dh siu naanak maaiaa ba(n)dh ||1||
lines.translation: Bound down by Maya, O Nanak, a foul odor clings to them. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਲਾ ਲਪਟਿ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: lalaa lapat bikhai ras raate ||
lines.translation: LALLA: People are entangled in the love of corrupt pleasures;

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਦ ਮਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aha(n)budh maaiaa mad maate ||
lines.translation: they are drunk with the wine of egotistical intellect and Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮਰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: iaa maaiaa mahi janamahi maranaa ||
lines.translation: In this Maya, they are born and die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jiu hukam tivai tiu karanaa ||
lines.translation: People act according to the Hukam of the Lord's Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਊ ਊਨ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooo oon na kooo pooraa ||
lines.translation: No one is perfect, and no one is imperfect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਊ ਸੁਘਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਮੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooo sughar na kooo mooraa ||
lines.translation: No one is wise, and no one is foolish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit jit laavahu tit tit laganaa ||
lines.translation: Wherever the Lord engages someone, there he is engaged.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਦਾ ਅਲਿਪਨਾ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak thaakur sadaa alipanaa ||11||
lines.translation: O Nanak, our Lord and Master is forever detached. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਅਥਾਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: laal gupaal gobi(n)d prabh gahir ga(n)bheer athaah ||
lines.translation: My Beloved God, the Sustainer of the World, the Lord of the Universe, is deep, profound and unfathomable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਸਰ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਵਰ ਕੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: doosar naahee avar ko naanak beparavaah ||1||
lines.translation: There is no other like Him; O Nanak, He is not worried. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਲਾ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਕੋਊ ॥
lines.transliteration: lalaa taa kai lavai na kooo ||
lines.translation: LALLA: There is no one equal to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਅਵਰ ਨਹ ਹੋਊ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekahi aap avar nah hooo ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the One; there shall never be any other.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਹੋਤ ਸਦ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hovanahaar hot sad aaiaa ||
lines.translation: He is now, He has been, and He shall always be.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਆ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: uaa kaa a(n)t na kaahoo paaiaa ||
lines.translation: No one has ever found His limit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਪੂਰ ਸਮਾਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: keet hasat mahi poor samaane ||
lines.translation: In the ant and in the elephant, He is totally pervading.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਭ ਠਾਊ ਜਾਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pragat purakh sabh thaaoo jaane ||
lines.translation: The Lord, the Primal Being, is known by everyone everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau deeno har ras apanaa ||
lines.translation: That one, unto whom the Lord has given His Love

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਤਿਹ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh har har tih japanaa ||12||
lines.translation: - O Nanak, that Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਸੁ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aatam ras jih jaaniaa har ra(n)g sahaje maan ||
lines.translation: One who knows the taste of the Lord's sublime essence, intuitively enjoys the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧਨਿ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਜਨ ਆਏ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dhan dhan dha(n)n jan aae te paravaan ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, blessed, blessed, blessed are the Lord's humble servants; how fortunate is their coming into the world! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਸਫਲ ਤਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਗਨੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaiaa saphal taahoo ko ganeeai ||
lines.translation: How fruitful is the coming into the world, of those

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਸੁ ਰਸਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਭਨੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaas rasan har har jas bhaneeai ||
lines.translation: whose tongues celebrate the Praises of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਬਸਹਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aai basahi saadhoo kai sa(n)ge ||
lines.translation: They come and dwell with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy;

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਰੰਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin naam dhiaavahi ra(n)ge ||
lines.translation: night and day, they lovingly meditate on the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮਹਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavat so jan naamahi raataa ||
lines.translation: Blessed is the birth of those humble beings who are attuned to the Naam;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਦਇਆ ਮਇਆ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kau daiaa maiaa bidhaataa ||
lines.translation: the Lord, the Architect of Destiny, bestows His Kind Mercy upon them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਹਿ ਆਵਨ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekahi aavan phir jon na aaiaa ||
lines.translation: They are born only once - they shall not be reincarnated again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har kai daras samaaiaa ||13||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they are absorbed into the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਯਾਸੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: yaas japat man hoi ana(n)d binasai doojaa bhaau ||
lines.translation: Chanting it, the mind is filled with bliss; love of duality is eliminated, and pain, distress and desires are quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖ ਦਰਦ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dookh darad trisanaa bujhai naanak naam samaau ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, immerse yourself in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
